description: This source file implements the EPONHAL class methods for managing and retrieving EPON hardware information, configurations, and statistics via associated API wrappers. It includes functions for initializing, cleanup, and providing detailed info about the EPON hardware, as well as methods for getting link stats, MAC tables, firmware info, and other device-specific parameters.

classes.name: EPONHAL
classes.description: The EPONHAL class provides methods to interact with the EPON hardware, including retrieving information, statistics, and controlling the device.

methods.description: Fetches device system descriptor info via ssp_EPONHAL_GetDeviceSysDescrInfo.

methods.name: void EPONHAL_GetOnuPacketBufferCapabilities(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Gets ONU packet buffer capabilities via ssp_EPONHAL_GetOnuPacketBufferCapabilities.

methods.name: void EPONHAL_GetLlidForwardingState(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Retrieves LLID forwarding state info using ssp_EPONHAL_GetLlidForwardingState.

methods.name: void EPONHAL_GetOamFrameRate(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Fetches OAM frame rate details via ssp_EPONHAL_GetOamFrameRate.

methods.name: void EPONHAL_GetDynamicMacTable(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Retrieves dynamic MAC address table via ssp_EPONHAL_GetDynamicMacTable.

methods.name: void EPONHAL_GetOnuLinkStatistics(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Gets ONU link statistics, supports min/max logical links, invokes ssp_EPONHAL_GetOnuLinkStatistics.

methods.name: void EPONHAL_GetStaticMacTable(IN const Json::Value & req,OUT Json::Value & response)
methods.description: Retrieves static MAC table via ssp_EPONHAL_GetStaticMacTable.

methods.description: Performs ONU reset via ssp_EPONHAL_SetResetOnu.
